programme.title: The Mighty Peking Man
programme.desc: A greedy Hong Kong businessman hires a young hunter to capture a giant gorilla said to live deep in the Indian jungle. The hunter finds the ape, and living with it he finds a feral human female who has befriended the creature.

programme.title: That Demon Within
programme.desc: A dutiful cop, guilt-ridden over saving the life of a gang leader, becomes obsessed with bringing down the crime syndicate of the man he saved.

programme.title: Let's Have A Baby
programme.desc: A charming tale of child-creating complications, featuring a rare comedic performance by Alex Man Chi-leung.

programme.title: The Macaque Monkey
programme.desc: The world is in chaos after the tree of life was burnt. Sun Wu Kong decides to return to the past to resurrect it, but his divine power is unstable after losing the golden hoop.

programme.title: I Love Lolanto
programme.desc: Small-time conman and mechanic Lolanto finds himself in trouble when he cheats gangster Yu Yan Tat out of his high-end sports car on a three-day loan, where new sparkplugs would have sufficed.

programme.title: Paper Man
programme.desc: A washed-up writer forms an unlikely friendship with a teenager from Long Island.

programme.title: Doubles Cause Troubles
programme.desc: Two squabbling cousins find themselves in more trouble than they can imagine after their tenant ends up dead. The gangsters and the police are both after them, and they have no idea what they have done wrong!

programme.title: Face To Face
programme.desc: Tamotsu dies in a skiing accident and his roommate Yoshio marries his wife as well as inherits his entire fortune. Things change, when Yoshio sees a badly disfigured old man at Tamotsu's funeral.

programme.title: The Mask Of Shura Of Fire Cloud
programme.desc: The Black Feather clan infiltrated the territory of Master Fire Cloud and stole The Mask of Shura, thus releasing an evil spirit that was a baby. Master Fire Cloud adopted the baby to prevent him from becoming evil.

programme.title: Painted Face
programme.desc: An action-thriller centered on a vampire-like woman who eats the skins and hearts of her lovers.

programme.title: Love Punch
programme.desc: The film revolves around a woman in her late twenties who rediscovers her talent for boxing after a long hiatus. She unexpectedly meets her former boxing coach and the pair work together to help her reach the final rounds of professional boxing matches.

programme.title: How To Pick Girls Up!
programme.desc: Xin, a helpless loser in love, calls in to a radio show hosted by DJ Tsang to ask desperately for help. A self-proclaimed love expert, Tsang takes it upon himself to make sure Xin meets girls and leads him on a series of absurd excursions into the wild and dangerous world of modern love.

programme.title: Seoul Raiders
programme.desc: JJ/Shu Qi and PI Lam (Dong jing gong lüe (2000)) steal 2 stolen USD100 plates in HK. Lam loses them - no US reward. Lam and his 3 cute angels try to get them again in Seoul as does JJ. Lots of fighting.

programme.title: Hong Kong, Hong Kong
programme.desc: A story of the illegal immigrant experience of people from the mainland of China who have made it to Hong Kong for a better life.

programme.title: Love On Delivery
programme.desc: A delivery boy Yin wants to impress his dream girl Li, so he enrols in a martial arts course to learn strange moves. Being timid, Yin saves Li while wearing a Garfield mask but the credit is stolen by Karate Master, Liu. To prove himself and win Li back, Yin defeats Liu in the ring with his unique martial arts move Invincible Wind and Fire Spin.

programme.title: Infernal Affairs
programme.desc: Ming is a mole in the police department and Yan is a police mole in the Triads. Leading parallel lives, Ming and Yan are feeling increasingly trapped in their false surroundings and they're desperate to find a way out.

programme.title: Winner Takes All
programme.desc: Two private detectives want to gain fame by solving a series of robberies. However, they were fooled by the King of Thieves during the investigation. It was later discovered that all the robberies were related to a Japanese businessman, Miyamoto.

programme.title: Mr. Vampire Saga 4
programme.desc: A Taoist Priest isn't happy when his Buddhist Priest colleague moves in next door. They are subject to feuds and duels, but soon must overcome their problems when a vampire breaks loose from his coffin and wreaks havoc to the countryside.

programme.title: Royal Tramp 2
programme.desc: Wei the jester, turned undercover spy, turned high ranking official in the Chinese imperial court, tries his best to deal with warring factions and deadly martial artists all vying for power.

programme.title: Sex Beyond The Grave
programme.desc: A woman is raped and murdered during World War 2. Forty years later she returns to haunt her persecutors from the Tao Tao Mansion. A professor and his family move into the house, only to have the spirits take their son.

programme.title: Fight Back To School
programme.desc: A SWAT team leader is forced by his captain to go undercover as a high school student to retrieve the captain's personal gun which was stolen during a school field trip to the police station.

programme.title: Shaolin
programme.desc: After ambushing and killing his rival, losing everything in the process, dispirited warlord Hou Jie turns to a Shaolin monastery seeking salvation.

programme.title: Unbeatable
programme.desc: Fai, once a world champion in boxing, escapes to Macau from the loan sharks and unexpectedly encounters Qi, a young chap who is determined to win a boxing match.

programme.title: Gorgeous
programme.desc: A romantic girl travels to Hong Kong in search of certain love but instead meets a kind-hearted professional fighter for whom she begins to fall instead.

programme.title: The Fate Of Reunion
programme.desc: Thousands of years ago, Green Snake gained enlightenment under the guidance of Dao Qing and gradually falls for him. However, her devotion to Dao Qing caused him to reincarnate and go through the pains of death.

programme.title: Let's Make Laugh
programme.desc: Security guard Lee Go is assigned to keep guard at a house while the owner is away. However, a series of hilarious misunderstandings occur.

programme.title: Shark Busters
programme.desc: During the financial crisis, a vast majority of Hong Kong people experience difficulties in repaying debts. During this time, loan sharks use ruthless ways to force debtors to repay their loans and it is up to Officer Lee and his underground team to hunt down the head of this illegal organization.

programme.title: Mother Vs Mother
programme.desc: Guan De Xing fell in love with Li Xiao Yun when he was young, but was opposed by his mother and had to marry Zhou Shen Yu. Since then, Li holds a grudge against Zhou.

programme.title: Dual Survival S6 - Eps. 12 Gator Bait
programme.desc: Berada di rawa-rawa terpencil di lembah sungai Atchafalaya, Louisiana, dengan air setinggi pinggang, EJ dan Jeff mendapati diri mereka dikelilingi oleh buaya dan ular berbisa.

programme.title: In The Eye Of The Storm S2 - Eps. 11 Escaping The La Fires
programme.desc: Pada tanggal 7 Januari 2025, percikan api di pegunungan Santa Monica memicu serangkaian kebakaran dahsyat yang menimbulkan kerusakan di seluruh Los Angeles.

programme.title: Expedition Files S2 - Eps. 3 Time Reveals All
programme.desc: Apakah Perang Troya hanya mitos, atau lebih dari itu? Benarkah Shakespeare menulis karya-karyanya? DNA akhirnya mengungkap identitas jenazah yang ditemukan di pantai lebih dari 80 tahun yang lalu.

programme.title: Wheeler Dealers World Tour S2 - Eps. 10 Scotland Hillman Imp
programme.desc: Mike dan Elvis hanya memiliki anggaran yang sangat terbatas untuk memperbaiki sebuah Hillman Imp. Dengan seorang jurnalis yang telah disiapkan untuk mengulas mobil yang sudah selesai, tekanan pun meningkat.

programme.title: Street Outlaws: Locals Only S2 - Eps. 12 Mr Michigan
programme.desc: Warga Michigan berkompetisi memperebutkan hadiah $5.000 dan sebuah mobil balap mengejutkan semua orang. Kemudian, peserta lokal terakhir yang bertahan akan berhadapan dengan Bobby Ducote untuk memperebutkan hadiah $5.000 lainnya.

programme.title: Street Outlaws: No Prep Kings: The Great Eight_S2 S2 - Eps. 8 A Win In Sin City
programme.desc: Para pembalap berjuang melawan ketinggian Colorado, dan pemimpin klasemen Kye Kelley berupaya meraih dua kemenangan berturut-turut. Giuseppe mencoba mengejar Kye.

programme.title: Kindig Customs S10 - Eps. 16 A Week In The Life
programme.desc: Liputan satu minggu dari Senin hingga Jumat mencakup berbagai cerita tentang apa yang sebenarnya terjadi di balik layar acara dan proyek-proyek yang sedang berjalan.

programme.title: High Speed Chase S2 - Eps. 2 Full Throttle
programme.desc: Di Florida, seorang pencuri perahu melarikan diri dari kejaran hukum, memicu pengejaran menggunakan perahu cepat. Sebuah truk U-Haul seberat enam ton yang diduga menyembunyikan barang curian terlihat.

programme.title: The Hindenburg Disaster: A Mysteries At The Museum Special
